questions.question: Variable kya hota hai?
questions.answer: Variable ek naam/reference hai jo kisi value ko access karne deta hai. Example: name = "Ashu" me name variable hai aur "Ashu" value hai.
questions.explanation: See model answer.

questions.question: Python ke common data types kaun se hain?
questions.answer: int, float, str, bool ke saath list, tuple, set aur dict common built-in types hain. NoneType bhi hota hai jab value nahi hai.
questions.explanation: TIP: 20-30 sec me clearly bolo. 20-30 sec me clearly bolo.

questions.question: Python dynamically typed kya hota hai?
questions.answer: Variable ka type pehle declare nahi karna padta. Value badalne par same name ke saath type bhi badal sakta hai.
questions.explanation: TIP: 20-30 sec me clearly bolo.

questions.question: type() aur isinstance() me fark?
questions.answer: type(x) exact type batata hai. isinstance(x, T) check karta hai ki object T ya uske compatible parent type ka instance hai.
questions.explanation: TIP: 20-30 sec me clearly bolo.

questions.question: Mutable vs immutable?
questions.answer: Mutable object ko same object me change kar sakte hain, jaise list/dict/set. Immutable me change karne par naya object banta hai, jaise int/str/tuple.
questions.explanation: See model answer.

questions.question: = aur == me fark?
questions.answer: = assignment karta hai. == values compare karta hai aur True/False return karta hai.
